disposition: A combative firebrand who is quick to point fingers and presses hard the moment a story wobbles.
diction: Speaks in short, hammering declaratives and names the person they doubt outright.
Raises the volume and repeats the charge until someone answers it.

disposition: A jittery worrier who thinks out loud in long, nervous run-ons.
diction: Piles clause upon clause without pausing for breath.
Second-guesses their own words mid-sentence and doubles back.

disposition: A terse, no-frills speaker who says exactly what they mean in as few words as possible.
diction: Answers in clipped fragments, often a single word.
Skips pleasantries and cuts straight to the point.

disposition: A careful equivocator who qualifies every claim and rarely commits to a firm position.
diction: Wraps statements in maybes, mights, and I-could-be-wrongs.
Trails off before landing on a definite conclusion.

disposition: A reflexive contrarian who instinctively argues the opposite of whatever was just proposed.
diction: Opens with 'actually' and takes the other side.
Challenges the consensus even when it stands alone.

disposition: A polished, old-fashioned formalist who speaks with unfailing politeness and full sentences.
diction: Addresses others by name with a courteous preface.
Chooses precise, slightly stiff vocabulary and never slang.

disposition: A homespun, folksy talker who wraps every point in an old saying or barnyard metaphor.
diction: Reaches for a proverb where others would state a plain fact.
Speaks slow and warm, like advice from a back porch.

disposition: A wisecracking cutup who defuses tension with a steady stream of one-liners.
diction: Slips a pun or a dry aside into almost every remark.
Keeps the mood light even when the room turns tense.

disposition: A cool, systematic reasoner who lays out the timeline step by step before drawing a conclusion.
diction: Numbers the points and walks through them in order.
Cites who was where and when in precise, measured phrasing.

disposition: A gentle mediator who looks for common ground and cools rising tempers.
diction: Reframes sharp remarks into softer, shared questions.
Invites the quieter voices to weigh in before things escalate.

disposition: A reserved watcher who says little and lets others fill the silence.
diction: Offers one spare sentence, then goes quiet again.
Speaks only when directly addressed, and briefly.

disposition: A relentless questioner who fires quick, pointed queries one after another.
diction: Stacks question on question without waiting for a full answer.
Drills into specifics of time and place at speed.

disposition: A hard-nosed doubter who questions every claim and takes nothing at face value.
diction: Answers assertions with a flat 'how do you know that?'
Pokes at the weakest link in whatever was just said.

disposition: An expansive narrator who recounts the whole sequence as a flowing, scene-by-scene story.
diction: Sets the scene with vivid detail before reaching the point.
Strings moments together with 'and then, and then'.
